Dirty Angels is a standalone novel and you absolutely can dive in without reading any of the other books, but just make sure you pick them up at some point! 
 Dirty Angels is without question very, very violent; very, very dirty and sexy. It is another WILD ride from Karina Halle!! The story takes place among Mexican drug cartel members in Mexico but at its heart, it is a tender (well, kind of) and beautiful love story. Javier commits unspeakable acts but he is also a human being and becomes obsessed with Luisa, after he kidnaps her and holds her for ransom, The problem is that Luisa has gone from one violent and dysfunctional man to another. She is incredibly resilient and strong but finds herself drawn to the very alluring Javier. 
 I found the sex scenes to be incredibly alluring and the alternating POV's worked perfectly here. I highly recommend this book if you want to read a story that is not all rainbows and unicorns but is instead filled with gritty characters, painful choices, incredibly satisfying love scenes and some wild, violent action. Another fantastic story from Karina Halle. #TeamJavier all the way, baby. 
 (*ARC provided by the author in return for an honest review.)

The first two books in this series left lots of unanswered questions which are all answered in thrilling fashion in Panic! I loved the way the author let us in on Rook and Ronin's histories. Wow! I wasn't expecting these stories. The last half of Panic is very fast-paced and almost morphed into a thriller which was fine by me. I absolutely love all the characters in these stories (even the ones I love to hate) but I really love Ford. 
 Rook turns into a very, strong heroine and you can see how resilient she really is. But she is far from perfect which is one of the things I liked about this story. I liked how she interacted with Ford and in particular there is a scene between her and Ford that could have taken a predicatble turn but didn't. 
 I love a dual POV book and the author does not dissapoint with giving us both Rook's and Ronin's POV. There are also plenty of steamy scenes in this book. Overall a very satisfying conclusion to Rook and Ronin's story. And more Ford please!

I recommend All of You to New Adult readers who are looking for something a little different. The reason? The hot male lead is a virgin! Bennett Reynolds, the sexy, tattoo-artist neighbor of nursing student Avery, is looking for a loving and meaningful relationship, and not just a random hook-up. Which is not to say he hasn't had some experience. 
 "Damn it, Bennett," I panted. "How in the hell do you know how exactly to drive me insane?" 
 "I said I was a virgin, Avery. Not a saint." 
 "Or even a monk, apparently," I mumbled. I felt him smile against my skin. 
 The main character, Avery, keeps giving away pieces of herself by hooking up with other guys but she keeps her real feelings locked away. With Bennett's help, she finds the strength to confront the demons in her past, and confront the past demons which keep her from forming a loving relationship. I liked how strong her character was. I also liked Avery's relationship with her best friends, which was funny and realistic. 
 The best part of All of You was without a doubt Bennett! I loved that he was both sexy and romantic, artistic and extremely honest. No game-playing here. I loved the dialogue between Bennett and Avery and yes, they had tons of chemistry together. All in all, Christina Lee's debut novel is a very refreshing and yet very sexy read. I am looking to more from her in the future!

4 1/2 stars! Canary is a very powerful debut Young Adult novel from Rachele Alpine. This book stunned me, and the author had me entranced with her very powerful writing style. The story of Kate and her struggles with a terrible situation in high school had me gripped from the first page, and I read this book in one sitting. This book also feels very fresh and modern because there are several important current events woven into the storyline. When I finished, I immediately bought this book for both my 17 year old daughter and her best friend. 
 Giving up your old friends, getting involved with superficial "friends", vicious gossiping, and academic cheating did not happen to Kate overnight; instead, she found herself on a slippery slope and before she knew it, she had turned into someone she didn't like very much. I applaud the author for writing what seems like a very realistic portrayal of high school today, and for not wrapping everything up into a neat little bow at the end. We see Kate grow as a person and face her problems head-on. I liked the strong but very human heroine she turns into, and I whole-heatedly recommend this book to anyone who wants to read a gritty, beautifully written YA novel that gives a small glimpse into the lives of high schoolers. It can be a very, very treacherous place. Thank you, Rachele Alpine for peeling back the layers, and giving us a glimpse inside.

4.5 stars! I was immediately drawn into this book and read it almost in one sitting! I loved the characters, and loved that the author featured a female musician, and not just the same predictable male rock star. Zoe is a tough-on-the-outside, brilliant but insecure up-and-coming singer and songwriter who finds herself on tour with Will, the hot bass player in a popular band. These characters have a lot of depth, and I loved seeing their relationship develop over the course of the story. 
 I am a big fan of dual POV's when done right, and and the author does an amazing job here with alternating between Zoe and Will's voice. There is lots of steam in this story and the scenes between Zoe and Will are natural, sexy and real all at once. An added bonus for me was that I picked up a few new Australian terms! I loved The Devil's Tattoo and highly recommend it for any fan of rock star books.

4.5 stars!! 
 In this follow-up to one of my favorite books of all time, Sempre, JM Darhower takes us on a tension-filled ride though the inner workings of a mob family. Carmine and Haven are forced to make heart-breaking and difficult decisions early in this story that lead to a surprising and thrilling read. Ms. Darhower is an extremely gifted writer and she has crafted memorable characters that will stay with you long after you finish this story. 
 Sempre opened with one of the most heartbreaking and harrowing scenes I have ever read. Carmine and Haven are two of my favorite fictional characters and I had been waiting anxiously for their story to continue. Sempre: Redemption is very much a gripping crime story, but really delivers on the emotion and romance. I was very sad to see Carmine and Haven's story come to an end, but the author delivers an absolutely fantastic conclusion! Overall, Sempre:Redemption is a beautifully written, dramatic and ultimately satisfying journey. 
 (ARC provided by the publisher in return for an honest review.)

3.5 stars!! I absolutely loved Lola Stark's first book in this series, Tattered Love, and couldn't wait for the second book! Conflicted Love is the story of Teeny and Trip, who we first met in Tattered Love. I highly recommend reading Book #1 first to get a feel for the background story of these characters, and also because it's a surprisingly engaging and sexy story. Teeny is a tough character, very independent, and finds herself in an unexpected situation after a hot night with the very sexy tatted and pierced Trip. She really doesn't want to fall for Trip but he does some pretty amazing things to prove himself a worthy partner. He has never been in a lasting relationship but to his credit, really fights his way into Teeny's life. Lots of really hot sex ensues, along with some very funny moments due to her pregnancy. I would have liked a little more depth to this story but overall, Conflicted Love is a fairly quick, really hot read with lots of very sexy and likable characters. 
 (ARC provided by the author in return for an honest review.)

And this is how it's done, class. 5+++ stars!! Perfectly written, Unteachable is one of those books that really defy a rating system. Gritty, sexy, gut-wrenching and lyrical, it is a story that will stay with you long after you have finished the last page. Exploring themes of friendship, loyalty, love, survival and acceptance, Leah Raeder writes in a way that will haunt you and make you question the very nature of right and wrong. Maise is not your typical heroine, and her story is both heartbreaking and triumphant at the same time. And the sex scenes are completely off the charts. Leah Raeder is incredibly gifted and it's hard to believe this is her debut book. Absolutely breathtaking book. Layered, nuanced, tragic, funny, and ultimately, hopeful. Move this book to the top of your TBR list!

Absolute perfection from beginning to end! 
 "It begins with a whimper but ends in a bang." 
 Tiffany Resisz has written what might be her best book so far! The story of how Eleanor and Soren first met is told in intimate detail as Nora tells the tale over one one night of passion with her lover. The Saint is told in flashback and although you might think you know the story, the funny, tragic and sexy details come to life at Tiffany Reisz's gifted hands. 
 "When we met he said, 'It's a pleasure to finally meet you.' We'd both been waiting for each other, like it was meant to be that we would find and love each other." 
 How Soren finally brings the wild and disobedient Eleanor under control is fascinating. Her relationship with her parents is heartbreaking and the blooming of Soren, Nora and Kingsley's inevitable and lifelong bond is a beautiful and very sexy thing to watch unfold. I could not put this book down and felt like I was spending time with some old (if not very dangerous) friends. I loved the switching back and forth between past and present as an adult Nora tells the story to her current lover (no spoilers as to his identity!) The Saint is another perfectly-written, highly erotic novel from Ms. Reisz, with a healthy dose of sarcasm and humor and even some religious eduction and philosophy thrown in. Don't miss this one! 
 (ARC provided via NetGalley)

4.5 stars!! I am always intrigued to read a novel written from a male POV. I am equally fascinated by pen names, and even when the writer professes to be one gender or the other (or leaves it open to the imagination such as BG Harlen), I still wonder at the back of my mind whether the author is a male or female. Do some female writers have a decidedly masculine POV? Yes, there are several that come to mind. Do some male writers have a feminine "flavor" to their writing? It seems so. 
 And so we come to the fascinating Thou Shalt Not. I loved Luke's story, as well as JJ Rossum's writing style, and don't want to be pigeon-holed into thinking that the author is male or female. That's just me. Either way, it's a very sexy and engaging book with plenty of steamy scenes to satisfy even the most jaded erotic romance reader (such as myself). The story carries some very weighty themes (domestic violence, adultery, the nature of beauty), but the book is very fast-paced and satisfying. Will Luke keep himself out of trouble with April? Will he learn to really love someone again? No spoilers here, but the author answers these questions while exploring what qualities are really important and what makes someone worthy of love. 
 This book has a very interesting conclusion that some readers will love, and some might find a little challenging. I loved it and can't wait to read more from this author. 
 *ARC provided by the author in exchange for an honest review.

Mikalo's Fate is a lush, sensual story that picks up with Mikalo Delis and Ronan, who are planning to wed in Greece. The two share a deep, spiritual connection and the sex scenes are erotic and beautifully written. The very wealthy and sexy Mikalo comes from a controlling, traditional family and none of them take kindly to Ronan upon her arrival in Greece. Ronan's only ally is her friend Deni who comes to her rescue during a wedding-dress shopping fiasco. To her credit, Ronan stands her ground with Mikalo's family, even though they do everything in their power to block the upcoming wedding. Most women would have run away without looking back! But Mikalo loves Ronan intensely, and he always makes her feel sexy, desirable and loved. This is a fairly quick, lushly written read that does not disappoint with the steam factor. The conclusion is very satisfying, and leads into a new storyline involving the very sexy Damen and Deni. I'm looking forward to more stories from Syndra involving sexy Greek guys!
Review to follow

After the major cliffy in Just Human, I couldn't wait to devour the continuation of Danny and Liv's story in Still Human! And what a gorgeously written sequel it is. I absolutely love Liv and Danny. And they have the best friends ever. They are so insecure and there are so many misunderstandings between them, that I was a wreck hoping they would both find a way to be together. Soul mates, right? Without any spoilers, I want to say that Danny is my next husband (LOVE him!) and Liv could be a great best friend. Still Human is loving and hot and sexy and romantic and has plenty of drama, too. And the covers of Being Human and Still Human are among my favorite book covers, ever. Kerry Heavens has a gift for storytelling and effortlessly switches between Danny and Liv's POV. I highly recommend getting to know Danny and Liv! You will totally fall in love with both of them.

4.5 stars!! 
 What can I say about Tarryn Fisher other than she is one of my favorite writers? Her style is powerful, clean, bold and unapologetic. Mud Vein is no exception. Senna and Isaac's story is not what you think, and not at all what you would you expect. This book totally took me off guard because I didn't read any reviews with spoilers in them. Like her earlier books (The Love Me with Lies series), this story is brutally honest, and is not a hearts-and-flowers, sugary-sweet romance. 
 The plot is incredibly inventive and different, and stunning as well. I fell in love with Isaac and by the end of the book, also really cared about Senna even though as with other characters written by Ms. Fisher, she is a prickly sort. I did not see the ending of this book coming, and it is really best if you don't know the ending as well. Mud Vein is another incredibly written book by Tarryn Fisher. She poured her heart and soul into this book and it really shows. I highly recommend Mud Vein. You won't soon forget it.
Hot and sexy! Review to follow on blog tour.

5+++ stars for The Mistress! This is an incredibly rich and completely satisfying conclusion to the Original Sinners series. All of the characters are brought together in The Mistress and their rich and complex stories are told in a very clever and gripping way. I can't do justice to a book that is so masterfully written and so filled with erotic and sensual images that I literally could not put it down. 
 You must read The Original Sinners series first so that you will be familiar with the intricate and complex histories of the gorgeous and fierce characters created by Tiffany Reisz. In The Mistress, Nora is forced to recount stories of her past with Kingsley and Soren. 
 "You're my favorite monster, she said against his lips." 
 "She felt pleasure with other men, ecstasy even sometimes...but only when Soren was inside her did she feel whole. 
 Soren and Kingsley spring into action to rescue Nora and both recall their memories of their relationship with Nora and with each other." 
 "Soren could not live in a world without Nora. Kingsley could not live in a world without Soren." 
 Wesley also rushes to help rescue Nora, along with Zachary's wife, Grace. Soren's niece Laila also forms an important part of the author's elaborate story of love, submission and erotica, a story that does not contain one false move or one unimportant character. 
 I don't want to give away any spoilers but suffice it to say that Tiffany Reisz has created a brilliant cast of characters and a story that will challenge you, thrill you and leave you breathless with anticipation. I was on the edge of my seat while reading The Mistress, hoping that Soren and Nora's unbreakable bond would get then through this latest crisis. 
 "The fire of her teenage infatuation with Soren had burned itself out years ago. In its flames a love made of iron had been forged. It could survive any blow, any trial." 
 The ending of this story was incredibly emotionally satisfying, and perfect for each character. The Mistress is a brilliant ending to an absolutely amazing series. 
 5+++ stars 
 Thanks to Harlequin and NetGalley for an ARC in exchange for an honest review.

Savor Me is a fairly quick and delicious read and a continuation of Taryn and Errol's story from Devour Me (Book #1). I strongly recommend you read the first book as it provides the background to Taryn and Errol's relationship. In Savor Me, Taryn has left Paris for New York, but Errol also winds up in the same city. They resume their steamy relationship but Taryn is very unsure of her place in his life. Errol's actions, however, speak volumes of his true intentions toward Taryn. They share some very hot scenes together, but the appearance of a Errol's former lover and a very hot firefighter named Matt complicate things. I absolutely loved the incredibly tender wide of Errol that we see in Savor Me. The author provides a very satisfying conclusion and a nice epilogue, which will lead nicely into Book #3 of the series!

So I am huge fan of 'I Love You to Death' and was thrilled to read an advance copy of 'Stubborn Love'. Two things you should know about this story: it take place parallel to ILYTD, and it moves back and forth between the past and the present. Flashbacks can be difficult to write but Natalie Ward absolutely hits it out of the park! The first thing I thought when I was reading Stubborn Love was that this book should be made into a movie, pronto. The writing, the setting, the story, all perfection. I absolutely love Jared, who is passionate, sexy and honest. What more can you ask for? 
 "Don't ever think that I don't want you Mia." 
 "Because I do, more than you'll ever know." 
 This is Jared and Mia's story. Mia is Luke's sister from ILYTD, and Jared and Luke were roommates and band mates. The story alternates between Jared and Mia's POV, which I loved. It is very difficult to write in both alternating POV's and in flashbacks but Ms. Ward is an incredibly gifted writer and she effortlessly switches back and forth between time frames and POV's. 
 Stubborn Love is an beautiful love story and has lots and lots of heat (like, a lot), passion and emotion. The entire story really only takes place over 24 hours but you get to witness almost the entire lifespan of a relationship because of the flashbacks. I was already a big fan of this author (sorry to repeat myself) and now I can't wait to read more of her writing, when Luke's POV is released! 
 **ARC provided by the author in exchange for an honest review.**

5 earth-shattering stars. I think my heart might have stopped a few times. ARSEN stands out in a sea of contemporary romance books for its engrossing story, richly written characters and fantastic sex scenes. You may not love Cathy but you will fall in love with Mia Asher's writing style and her characters. They are not always what they seem and the story is a complete and total emotional roller coaster ride. I love books where not everything is black and white. Arsen is a nuanced story with many, many layers. A must-read.

Pay attention to the content warning, because this books contains sex, lots and lots of SEX! And it is HOT! Tattered Love is an outstanding debut from Lola Stark, filled with a fast-paced, well-written storyline, lots of interesting characters and most importantly, the fantastic, swoon-inducing, hot-as-hell MACE! This man is so hot, he practically jumps off the page! 
 Tattoo artist Sacrlett knows she is in for trouble when Mace walks in to her tattoo parlor. The brother of one of her artists, Mace never forms a connection with women, until of course, he meets the smart, sexy and very strong-willed Scarlett. These two have sizzling chemistry right from the start, and I loved that Mace went for it right from the beginning. And in between the wonderfully steamy sex scenes, there's actually a good story, too! Mace and Scar both have secrets in their pasts that threaten their happiness together. But the last part of the book was not what I expected and I loved every single word! 
 I am normally not a huge fan of secondary characters, but this group are funny, loyal, interesting and well-written. This is a fabulous, sexy debut novel from this author! Although I read Tattered Love quickly, I did not want it to end, and I can't wait for more from Lola Stark!!

This story has enough scorching sex scenes to satisfy even the most jaded reader! And wait, there's a great story, too! I absolutely fell in love with Addison, what a survivor, and Cade will have you swooning from the second you meet him (in the book, of course). Addison has lived through the most unimaginable childhood and her tough-as-nails exterior hides a world of pain and hurt. She locates her father, Jackson, who is the bad-ass President of the Hell's Knights MC. Their story is completely heartbreaking and makes for a solid foundation for the story. 
 And Cade. OMG, talk about a cocky, sexy, alpha biker. I highlighted almost every one of his scenes but they are almost all too hot for repeating here. He and Addison literally burn up the pages! I read this book in one sitting and could not wait to read more about these characters. There's heartbreak, lust, revenge, love, tons of dirty talk and really hot sex in Hell's Knights. The writing is tight and fast-paced and the characters are well-developed. You want a down-and-dirty, loaded-with-alphas book? Here it is. Bravo, Bella! 5 panty-melting stars.

Kyran is a conservative, successful businessman by day and a bare-knuckled fighter by night. Few know his secret obsession with fighting, at least until Dale comes along: 
 "This was what he needed. This was what he lived for. No amount of buying and selling businesses could beat the buzz he got from it. Tomorrow would be better - his senses would be heightened and his rigid control would return." 
 Kyran and his brother Taylor work together in their family buiness. Dale Porter is hired as Taylor's assistant and the minute she meets Kyran, there is no denying the sexual attraction between them. Kyran is an Alpha male, pure sex, and Dale captivates him with her smart and witty demeanor. These two can't fight their attraction, and the author really steams up the pages with these two! This book is filled with raw, explicit sex scenes that literally burn up the pages. 
 Dale knows she should not have a relationship with her boss's brother but there is no denying Kyran Reese! 
 "When she looked into his eyes, she almost lost all logic. The desire that clouded his eyes left her fumbling for words." 
 One problem: Kyran Reese doesn't do relationships, and their relationship is supposed to be strictly about the sex. The author kept me turning the pages to see how Dale would deal with Kyran's inability or just plain unwillingness to show his true feelings. 
 "Dale. Don't push this. I'm being honest. I'm giving you what I can." - Kyran 
 Oh, and besides all the smoking hot sex, there is plenty of family drama and lots of bare-knuckled boxing action. If you want a steamy, sexy, action-filled book, that's also a fairly quick read, then you will love Beneath the Surface. 
 *ARC provided by NetGalley*

4.5 stars! I absolutely loved this story, which follows Jack as he moves far away after the events in Seduce. Although this is a standalone, you should read Seduce first to get an understanding of why Jack feels the way he does about relationships, and also because it is a very creative and surprising story. 
 Jack is now living his life in a new city and meets Rose, who also has lots of secrets in her past. Jack might not be the nicest person, but he is drawn to Rose and treats her differently from most women. 
 There are lots of steamy scenes in this story, along with some great supporting characters. Missy Johnson really knows how to amp up the chemistry, and the sex scenes do not disappoint! I was really rooting for Jack and Rose, I felt connected to the characters and overall I really loved this story. 
 (ARC provided by the author in return for an honest review.)

4 1/2 stars! 
 Seduce is told from Jack's POV, an unapologetic, hard-partying womanizer: 
 "The thing is, I'm happy being me and I sure as fuck won't change for anyone. I don't need fixing because I'm not broken. I simply work hard and play harder. Things are great. I'm exactly where I want to be at twenty-five years old." 
 Seduce totally grabbed me from the very beginning and I read it one sitting. Jack is a rich, callous, irresistible bachelor, who is quite honest about the way he treats women. But I also found him very vulnerable and likable, with a strong support group of very close friends and a brother with whom he shares a close bond. The rest of his family, not so much, which is where his feelings of unworthiness and abandonment come from. Enter the gorgeous and spirited Belle, with whom Jack actually develops a deep emotional attachment. Seduce was going in one direction, with lots of super-steamy and graphic sex scenes, and then, whoa, suddenly took a complete left-turn! This book is a surprising, sexy book with a fabulous conclusion! Looking forward to the next installment from the author, Beautiful Rose. 
 *A copy of the book was provided by the author in exchange for an honest review.*

Three Daves is a very well written, humorous story about a young college student and her search for true love (and sexual experience!) in the Eighties. As the title might suggest, our heroine Jen meets three guys named David and the story follows her relationship with each of them. 
 There are Bible verses quoted at the end of each chapter which are interesting and thought provoking. This story is a very light-hearted read about self-discovery and finding true love. Overall, I found this to be a very charming book and I loved being transported back to the Eighties. 
 If you are looking for a well-written and witty story with some steam, and a happily ever after, Three Daves is for you! Ms. Elson is a very talented writer and I look forward to reading more of her books.

'Beneath the Burn' has it all: gritty and thrilling story, deep romance, BDSM, strong characters, darkness and light. Definite 6-star read for me and one of the best books of the year. Charlee and Jay are deeply flawed, richly drawn characters who I cared about from the very first page. Charlee endures almost unimaginable pain and horror at the hands of her captor yet emerges as a survivor. Jay has also endured severe trauma and struggles to deal with his past in his own way. This book has everything that I love: graphic sex, strong characters, a thrilling storyline, and very dark and gritty elements. This book will stay with you long after you finish. I can't recommend it highly enough.

This story hooked me from the dramatic beginning, as we witness Phoenix Harper's attempted suicide. The story unfolds as she is brought to a psychiatric hospital and starts to slowly heal and get her life back together. She meets handsome medical student and intern Braeden, who also happens to be the son of her treating physician. 
 This book is written in first person present tense, and has the alternating points of view of Phoenix and Braeden. I enjoyed the author's writing style. This is not a light, romantic story. It is the story of two people who are very sensitive, and who have suffered thorough some very emotional events in their lives. 
 I also loved the supporting characters of Rain and Donovan! They are a great addition to the story. 
 This story is not heavy on the steam but there is just the right amount of romance and sex, perfect for the story. 
 There is an incredibly dramatic twist at the end of this story that I promise, you will not see coming! I give the author a lot of credit for crafting the surprising ending to this book. Overall, I enjoyed this debut story very much, despite the heavy subject matter. I am looking forward to reading more from this author!A Brand New EndingS.A. Rolls

4 1/2 stars! Frontline is an exciting read that is not your average contemporary romance story! It has a thriller aspect that I loved. The author has created some very memorable characters in Sara Peters and Trenton Merrick. Trenton is not your typical sexy billionaire businessman. There is a lot more to this story, and I loved that he throws Sara off guard. 
 There are also great supporting characters here that I would love to read more about. I absolutely felt connected to Sara and Trenton and loved Sara's POV. 
 There is plenty of sexual tension to go around in Frontline, but it is also funny and very thrilling. I love being taken by surprise, and this book certainly does that. I also love the first person POV and the very erotic elements of the story. I loved the sexy bodyguards as well. I can't WAIT for more from Alexandra Richland!

*ARC received in return for an honest review 
 Wow,what a wild ride. As a huge fan of the Edge of Never, I picked up this book without knowing anything about the story, I only knew that Andrew and Camryn would be making a cameo appearance. 
 Bray and Elias met as children and grew up best friends, Bray was pretty much ignored by her family and suffered from benign neglect. She seemed like the wild child but really she was afraid to form bonds or attachments to people because she didn't understand that the other people could actually care for her. 
 Elias was in love and devoted to Bray no matter what. This New Adult book contained some pretty spicy sex scenes but I felt they fit in with the story of the young characters as they grew and explored the world and their relationships. 
 A shocking event occurs and Bray and Elias find themselves on the road. Many adventures ensue, and they meet up with another group young wanderers. I never thought there would be a HEA to this story based on their almost daily physical struggles and Bray's battle with bipolar disorder. depression. Elias would never leave a Bray no matter what, so it was difficult to see how there would be a satisfying conclusion to this book, but there was. 
 I read several very negative reviews of this book and I don't agree at all. This book has enough drama, emotion and sexy times to satisfy any fan of New Adult books. Even though the ending seemed bleak at one point, I was very happy to see Bray and Elias get the ending they so deserved.
Super-hot m/m story, great for a quick steamy read! First book I've read by Kim Dare and it won't be my last. LOVED the characters and the sex scenes. WOW!!

4 1/2 hot stars for this second-chance love story. 
 First, please note the author's warning about the domestic violence scenes. They are intense! With that said, this is the story of misunderstandings, missed opportunities and a second chance at love. Years before, Izzy waited for Axel to return home from basic training, but a series of miscommunications and misunderstandings kept them apart. Izzy goes on to marry Brandon, who she thought was a wonderful guy, but it turned out she was entering into a horrible, abusive marriage. 
 "People say karma is a bitch but I have news for you, karma doesn't have anything on fate when she is after blood. Not a single thing." 
 "The past can't touch me. I am stronger than this. I am a survivor." 
 Izzy is literally saved from her abusive marriage by her best friend Dee, and by chance runs into Axel one night. He has started Corps Security with his friend Greg Cage, who also happens to be Izzy's friend and protector. Axel is shocked to see Izzy again, the woman he thought had abandoned him years before. 
 "She was mine. She is mine. She will always fucking be mine." 
 Izzy tries desperately to avoid confronting Axel because he had ripped her heart out years before. But Axel will not let her go so easily this time and demands that they clear the air. 
 "Sugar, I have thought about sex, hard fucking dirty sex, about a hundred times since we sat down to eat." "Does that clear it up for you?" 
 "Never again, Izzy West. I will never again let anyone take you from me, or anything from us." His words hang between us both as a promise and a threat." 
 Cathy and I loved this book! We love Izzy, who was a fighter through all of the very rough events in her life. We love Axel, who still wants to protect Izzy, even though he too thought she had abandoned him years before. This book is filled with hot guys, rough talk and explicit sex. What's not to love? 
 "Never letting you go, Izzy. Never." He whispers into my hair, squeezing me a little tighter. 
 "I always have been yours, you know that, don't you?" 
 This is a super-hot, fast-paced read filled with Alpha males and a second-chance love story. There are also some great supporting characters in Axel and it looks like Greg Cage will be getting his own story. Sign us up, please!

Very enjoyable story! Search Me is a fairly quick, suspenseful and action-packed story from the very talented Katie Ashley. 
 The story is told from the point of view of Lane, a young dance teacher who is spending her summer in the mountains of north Georgia, as she has done since she was a young girl. She is reunited with Maddox (love the name!), who was her first love and who also happened to break her heart when she was younger: 
 "When it comes down to it, you've always been the one, Maddox. Since I was fourteen years old, there's never been another for for me, and there never will be." 
 Lane and Maddox quickly wind up with a treasure map. Much drama ensures as Lane and Maddox end up on the run from villains who are also trying to get the map. Search Me is a fast-paced and suspenseful book, with a little romance, too! There is also a nice history lesson in here which was very enjoyable. 
 All in all, Katie Ashley delivers an engrossing story with interesting characters that is lots of fun to read!Search MeKatie Ashley

BULLY is an instant classic! Tate and Jared's story pulled me in from the very first page, and I read this book straight through in one sitting. I could not wait to see how this story ended, and the author gave me everything I wanted and more. This book is a must-read. It has everything I need from a great stand-alone book: characters I care deeply about, a storyline that had me guessing from the beginning, very strong supporting characters and a conclusion that blew me away! There are even some steamy sex scenes which fit the story perfectly. I am so excited that Ms. Douglas has more books planned for some of the characters she introduced in BULLY, because I can't get enough of her writing! Read BULLY, you will not be disappointed

Fixed on You had been on my TBR list for quite some time and let me tell you, if you are in the same boat, MOVE THIS BOOK UP NOW! I absolutely devoured this story and am so excited to be able to read the next book as soon as possible, even though there really is no cliffhanger here. I just loved the story that much and want to read more about these characters. The plot is a little different from your normal gorgeous-millionaire-meets-beautiful-girl story: our heroine Alayna actually has serious stalker tendencies in her past so she has not allowed herself to become romantically attached to anyone. Hudson, our HOT Alpha also has some interesting secrets in his past, too. This book is pure reading pleasure: well-written characters, amazingly hot sex scenes, a connection between the main characters and a creative storyline. My heart ached for both Alayna and Hudson during certain parts of this book! The author has also created one of the most treacherous mothers out there as well as a great supporting cast of characters. I can't wait to see where Hudson and Alayna's story goes in the next book! 
 (Copy provided by the author in return for an honest review.

4 1/2 stars! HOT, fast-paced story in the Songs of Submission series. 
 I absolutely love picking up a book by an author who had previously been unknown to me. Beg was a total surprise and was a fast-paced, sexy read! The characters are all very well-developed and the Los Angeles settings are written with a lot of thought and description. I loved the characters of Monica and Jonathan, and the storyline is very engaging. I recommend this very sexy novella when you need a hot dose of a very charming alpha male and a smart, spirited heroine. My only complaint about BEG...it was too short! But the good news is that the author has written a whole series of novellas and I can't wait to read more of her writing.

An emotional and sometimes humorous story of self-discovery and the search for a "perfect" soulmate. Chloe is a budding artist and is preparing for her first gallery exhibit. If you love reading about the art and photography world, this book is for you. I absolutely loved the author's description of Chloe's passion and drive in pursuing her dream of displaying her first photography exhibit. The story was a bit slow for me, however, in the development of Chloe's budding romance with the mysterious Christopher, who Chloe "meets" online through a mutual acquaintance. 
 Chloe wants to find the love of her life, and I enjoyed reading about her journey toward self-discovery and possibly, romance. The author also created a very memorable group of supporting characters that are all essential to the story. This is a very well-written book and is perfect for anyone who loves chick-lit with a dramatic twist and a little edge. The ending was a complete surprise but made perfect sense. 
 (A copy of this book was provided in exchange for an honest review.)

Lovely story that touches your heart. 
 This is a beautifully written story of loss, love and letting go of the past. Holly has lost her boyfriend Adam in a tragic mountainside accident. She is attending college but not really living life at all. Her best friend Jenna fully supports her emotionally but wants her to get back to living life. Holly begins a friendship with the hunky Carter and slowly begins to feel emotions she has thought were buried away, never to surface again. 
 Fall From Love is what I call a "slow burn" story - the author really takes her time in building her characters' connection to each other and in developing their relationship. You really feel connected to Holly and Carter and feel their yearning and their pain. Carter blames himself for Adam's accident and hides his involvement in the tragic events from Holly, even as she is falling in love with him. The emotional storyline is lightened up a little by the presence of Jenna and her boyfriend Josh, who also happens to be Carter's roommate. 
 The author also delivers a very satisfying conclusion to a wonderfully developed story. Fall From Love is an extremely engrossing book, and I look forward to reading more from this author! 
 (Copy provided by the author in exchange for an honest review)

4.5/5 stars! Great rocker romance. Full review to follow. 
 ARC supplied by New GalleyLickKylie Scott

The Runaway Year is a very entertaining summer read! If you like a little escapism with your reading, this book is for you. I absolutely loved the Cornwall beach setting, which was the perfect background for the romantic escapades of our three heroines. 
 There is some steam in The Runaway Year, between Layla and her very hot neighbor Joseph. The author does a great job with their romance, and I would love to see more between these two in the future! Layla undergoes an emotional journey throughout the book and I was really rooting for her to open her eyes and appreciate what was right in front of her. 
 I really loved all three friends, but I most loved Layla's story. Another stand-out for me was the somewhat magical beach setting. I have always wanted to visit Cornwall (it was the setting of many romance novels I read as a young girl) and the author does a wonderful job of making the setting a crucial part of the story. 
 I highly recommend this book if you want a bit of romantic escapism and a fairly light but very entertaining summer read. I am very much looking forward to reading more from Shani Struthers!

Mid-Life Love is an entertaining story with very strong characters, and lots and lots of very steamy sex! I enjoyed reading a book where the main characters weren't 22 years old. Claire and Jonathan actually had substance to their characters, and I loved the younger-guy-older-woman story. This is the perfect book to lose yourself in, and just enjoy the story. I loved the San Francisco setting, and the secondary characters were well-thought-out also. I felt that Claire could have stopped doubting her relationship with Jonathan a little earlier on; I mean, here was a smart, successful businessman who clearly had real feelings for her and wasn't bothered at all by their age difference. Claire's continued insecurities were the only sticking point for me. The ending more than made up for that, and anyone who loves a HEA will love this book! I would have loved even a short prologue, though, but all in all, a great, escapist read with a neat and tidy conclusion.
***6 stars!!*** Full review to come. This is a must-read!!
Perfection! Jack and Keri Ann are incredible characters. Full review to follow.

I was totally hooked into Worth the Fight from the first page and absolutely fell in love with Nico Hunter! 
 We meet attorney Elle James who is a total workaholic and keeps her steady boyfriend pretty much at arms' length. Everything in her life is emotionless and neatly planned, just like she wants it. Elle doesn't want any drama or surprises in her life. Of course, all of this changes in a heartbeat when she meets MMA fighter Nico Hunter, and she knows her life will never be the same. 
 I've never seen a body like his so close before. It just doesn't seem real. Both of his arms are covered in tattoos, it looks like he's wearing colorful sleeves, only he has no shirt on. They intertwine and wrap around his bulging biceps and I get the urge to trace a path from the first splat of ink to the last with my tongue. My body's reaction to him is unlike anything I've ever felt before. These aren't feelings that I'm used to, they seem to come out of nowhere and are uncontrollable. 
 There are very painful reasons why Elle keeps her life relatively everything drama-free, and Nico, too, has had a traumatic event in his life which is revealed very early on in the book. Luckily for Elle, Nico knows what he wants and goes after it and wow! Nico is one HOT Alpha male, a really gorgeous, sexy and actually NICE guy who tries to break down the walls around Elle's heart and emotions. 
 I know I could have taken it further after that kiss. But I don't want one night with Elle. I want more. I have no idea why, but I do. A lot fucking more. 
 I absolutely love Nico! He took my breath away! He is tough, sensitive, strong and tender all at once. He loves his family and they form a tight bond around him. He has a loyal group of friends and trainers around him. Elle doesn't feel worthy of him or his attention and all of this builds to an amazing climax which will have you on the edge of your seat, crying and cheering at the same time. 
 Ms. Keeland has written a very adult story, with adult themes and problems, along with some of the most breathtaking love scenes I've ever read. Have a cold shower ready when you read Worth the Fight, you'll need it! I literally cannot wait for more stories in this series from Ms. Keeland.

We loved this latest installment in the Maddox Brothers' saga! Trent is hard-loving, hard-working, loyal and completely devoted to Cami. She is a good girl dealing with a bad family situation and trying to keep up with two jobs, school and TJ, her long-distance boyfriend who is does not seem to have much time for her because of his mysterious job in California. 
 What we loved best about this story is the devotion of Trenton to Cami. At first he comes off as a player but he is far from that and when he makes his true feelings known to Cami, he is totally swoon-y. He's uber-sexy, hot and protective. 
 "Because I've been in love with you since grade school, Chamomile. And everyone knew it. Everyone." 
 We also loved Cami, she is dealing with more than her share of stress between her seriously dysfunctional family, school, juggling two jobs and her mystery boyfriend TJ in California. We both really liked this book because of our devotion to the Maddox Brothers, BUT we did not like how Trent's longtime love for Cami was not described in more detail, maybe through a memory, or another scene or two. That led to a little bit of a disconnect between the two main characters. We are sworn to secrecy about giving away any spoilers but be aware there is a SHOCKER of an abrupt, surprise ending! Cathy figured it out from the beginning but I was clueless. And, the author just announced that the next installment will be BEAUTIFUL REDEMPTION, the oldest Maddox Brother's story. We will definitely read the next book because who doesn't absolutely love the Maddox Brothers??! 
 (*ARC provided by Atria in return for an honest review)

I don't usually read a lot of paranormal books so King Hall was a little something different for me! This is a magical, imaginative story that follows Lily, a young prodigy who is suddenly forced to become a leader along with three other friends. Lily is a "hybrid", which is very dangerous in the mystical world created by Scarlett Dawn. The action-packed story follows young Lily as she experiences loss, self-doubt and many epic challenges on her path to becoming the leader she is meant to be. 
 The author has created some great supporting characters in Ezra, Jack and Pearl. I especially enjoyed reading about the relationship and strong connection between Lily and Ezra, the sexy Vampire. There is lots of talk about sex and sexual tension in this book, but nothing too explicit. 
 King Hall ends with a cliffhanger, but it is the kind of ending that leaves you ready for the next installment in this story! This book was a very different read, and I recommend it for anyone interested in stories about magical, mystical worlds. 
 I received this book from NetGalley in exchange for an honest review.

Thank you to Mia Sheridan for the amazing opportunity to read an ARC of Leo's Chance! And to all of the readers who have experienced Leo, you must read this book. I was absolutely blown away by the writing, the characters, the story, and the very, very steamy sex!! This book had everything I love about a great book. Mia Sheridan is an absolutely amazing writer. This series is going on my list of favorite books. 
 Please read Leo, Book One in this series, before you read Leo's Chance. It is told from Evie's POV and you will be lost on some of the details and characters in this book without having read Leo. 
 I LOVE Leo! He is hiding a terrible trauma, desperate to get close to Evie, and trying to get closure on his very troubled past. 
 Leo and Evie both grew up in the foster system and he vowed to return for her when she turned 18. That became impossible and now 8 years later, he enters her life again: 
 "After only a couple days of following Evie, I was pretty damn sure that I was already even more in love with her than I was when I was 15 years old. Now I just had to figure out what the hell to do." 
 Nothing I write here will do justice to this incredible story of abuse, shame, betrayal and ultimately, honesty and the power of love. Leo's flashbacks to his time in the foster care system are gut-wrenching. I can't even imagine doing the research for this part of the story. My heart went out to these fictional characters and to all kids in the foster care system. 
 Leo's feelings for Evie are incredibly intense even though he is filled with doubt and self-loathing. But Leo's Chance is not just the story of two broken kids in the foster care system. It is an amazing love story, with some graphic and super-steamy sex scenes! "World's Greatest", indeed! 
 "This is the second most incredible kiss of my life. The first was with the same girl." 
 This book contained one of the best epilogues I have ever read. Leo's Chance is a must-read. I can't wait to read more from Mia Sheridan!Leo's ChanceMia Sheridan

41/2 stars! Unspoken tackles a serious topic with an engaging storyline, a little humor and plenty of steam. This book took me by surprise, and I loved every single word! This book is a follow-up to Undeclared but it absolutely can be read as a stand-alone. 
 AM and Bo are college students, but AM stays on the fringes of campus life because of horrible bullying she suffered at the hands of a small but very vocal group of students. Bo is a total Alpha, over-protective, gorgeous, but with a huge and loving heart. He has noticed AM from afar, and is thrilled when they end up in a class together. Bo doesn't care about AM's "reputation" and pushes her to open up and take a chance on him. Did I mention that I love Bo? He is a former Marine, an MMA fighter and unbelievably hot. I am a huge fan of dual POV's when done right, and boy, does the author hit the mark here! I was also thrilled with the development of AM's character throughout Unspoken and was cheering for her by the end. There is the perfect amount of steam in Unspoken and characters that I grew to love. Add a great storyline to that mix, and you have a book that should not be missed. I can't wait for more from Jen Frederick!!

4.5/5 stars! This was a totally surprising read by a wonderful author! 
 Mary Whitney is a fantastic writer and she gives us an absolutely beautiful story about first love. The story tells us what happened years before between Nicki and Adam. Nicki has never really gotten over Adam, even though they were very close while in high school. Adam helped Nicki cope with the sudden death of her sister and Nicki falls for him. 
 This book has a much more emotional feel than most stories about high schoolers. I felt that both Nicki and Adam were very mature for their age, which I appreciated. All in all, this is a wonderful story with very well-written characters. The author throws a few things in the way of Nicki and Adam finally being together, and the ending will really leave you wanting to read much more from Mary Whitney! 
 (ARC provided by publisher in exchange for an honest review)Beside Your HeartMary Whitney

Short and spicy novella about an innocent young girl and a wealthy older guy...okay, that might sound a little familiar but this is actually a very enjoyable, well-written erotic story that I read in about 30 minutes. Surprising ending! Looking forward to the next book in this series. AwakeningSerena Grey

When an author begins her book by recommending another book to read to get a feel for her topic matter, I AM HOOKED. I didn't think I could love a character as much as Horse, but I absolutely LOVE Ruger! Once again, the author has created a gut-wrenching story, super hot, tattooed bikers and some SMOKING HOT sex scenes. I was a little frustrated with Sophie in the beginning of the book, I mean, talk about bad choices, but I absolutely love her and Ruger together. And his tattoos...OMG. This is one uber-Alpha who knows what he wants and protects what's his. Joanna Wylde is an incredibly gifted writer and the second book in the Reapers MC series is a sexy, wild and beautiful story. Enjoy the ride!

What a surprising debut by Ember Casey! I loved this very well-written and sexy story of Lily Frazer and Calder Cunningham, two of my new favorite characters. The book follows Lily as she sets out to confront Calder over what she sees as a breach of his binding promise to fund the non-profit arts center founded by her father. He has turned down her many efforts to contact him over his decision to stop funding the Frazer Center, so she decides to take matters into her own hands and confront him in person. 
 What I thought would be the same, predictable, girl-meets-sexy-billionaire story turned into so much more! Of course Lily finds Calder very handsome, and at first she resists her attraction to him but then as she gets to know him better, she lets herself go wild. 
 "By my estimation, he's the perfect specimen of a man - why no one's tried to carve a copy of this one out of marble yet, I can't guess." 
 The two are forced by circumstance to spend time alone together at Calder's estate, and over the course of a few days, they begin a wild and passionate relationship. Lily begins falling for the gorgeous but aloof Calder. This might sound like a predictable plot but there is so much more to this delicious book! 
 "The passionate, dominant Calder I can handle - the one who leaves bruises on my skin and shoves my shirt into my mouth to keep me silent - but I don't know how to deal with this gentler version of him." 
 Ms. Casey can write! The sex scenes are HOT and the storyline is realistic and interesting and kept me turning the pages to see where she would take these characters next. I LOVED the ending (don't worry, no real cliffhanger) and all I wanted was to keep reading more of Lily and Calder! Fantastic debut by Ember Casey. Can't wait for Book Two, Truth or Dare coming late Summer/Fall 2013.

"Bingo. Fuse lit." 
 Crashed is an absolutely breathtaking and stunning conclusion to the Driven Trilogy! I don't ever write long reviews but for some reason it has been very difficult for me to put into words the emotions that this book instilled in me. It has been a bag of mixed emotions saying goodbye to Colton and Rylee. 
 Spiderman. Batman. Superman. Ironman 
 I had a million theories about where this book would go after the absolutely heart-stopping ending of Fueled. It is a tribute to the author's incredible talent that all of my theories were wrong, and Colton and Rylee's story took me on an emotional journey that has stayed with me weeks after finishing this book. I felt every gut-wrenching scene, every emotional high and low and every triumph right down to my very soul. 
 There are some absolutely beautiful scenes in Crashed and there are some absolutely soul-punching, nail-biting ones, too. Each scene felt essential to the book, and I also loved how every character was fully explored in Crashed. I was on the edge of my seat throughout most of Crashed, but yet at the same time I didn't want to say goodbye to Colton and Rylee. This is a substantial, juicy story that is meant to be savored and enjoyed. And the Epilogue! Kristy Bromberg has earned a place in my heart previously reserved only for Kristen Ashley and Jodi Ellen Malpas with the fantastic Epilogue in Crashed. 
 "Remember, hurting is feeling and feeling is living and isn't it good to be alive?" 
 Colton's painful past is fully explored in Crashed and many questions are answered. Rylee continues to be one of the strongest heroines around and had me cheering and weeping throughout many parts of the book. The plot is very inventive and there are several relationships that I hope the author will explore in the future. Do not miss Crashed. It is absolute perfection, "A to motherfucking Z"!! 
 (ARC provided by the author in return for an honest review.)

"She's my motherf***ing checkered flag." Easily one of my favorite books this year. Disclaimer: I am no writer, so anything I say here will not be able to do justice to the amazing writing talent of K. Bromberg! 4 1/2 emotion-filled stars for this beautifully written story! I absolutely loved this story about Cali, a girl whose life is "empty, closed off and bleak," even though outwardly she plays the part of the popular, carefree party girl. Cali devotes her time and energy to torturing Logan, planning one elaborate prank after another. Why does she hate Logan so much? The author keeps us guessing, only revealing that once upon a time, Logan was the best friend of Cali's brother, Ben. The story kept me turning the pages to find out why Logan allowed Cali to hate him so much, and what actually happened to Ben: 
 "Our rivalry is beautiful, because it makes us both forget about everything else." 
 It turns out that Cali and Logan actually have a lot more in common than Cali thought at first. They both love poetry, which plays a very important role in 'Two Roads.' As much as Cali's hateful behavior frustrated me at times, I absolutely loved Logan! He is a gorgeous nerd, who allows Cali to vent her emotions and hatred towards him, and just does not back down. 
 Logan sees the "real" Cali underneath her hateful and mean treatment of him, and tries to help her let go of her anger, and tries to shows her that her life can have meaning. He is funny, sensitive and caring. Although he plays along with Cali's constant pranks and her relentless hatred of him, he realizes what they have together. Will Cali ever recognize what is right in front of her? Will Logan let Cali push him away? 'Two Roads' answers all of these questions in a very emotionally satisfying conclusion. And trust me, Logan has now become of my favorite book boyfriends. 
 "Because you stole my heart, Cali," he whispers, running his hand along my cheeks. "You stole my heart and now you won't let me have yours." 
 Two Roads is a wonderfully-written, emotion-filled story that shows that no matter how hard you search, sometimes love is right in front of you. Well done, L.M. Augustine! Looking forward to many more books from this very talented writer. 
 Favorite quote: 
 "I guess I love 'The Road Not Taken' because it's saying that no matter what, you always get a choice in life."
Loved this series. Sorry this is the end of their story. Review to follow.

I had the great pleasure of receiving an ARC of Broken Beauty. Erin and Blake's story continues in Book #3 of the Beauty Series and it is phenomenal! Each of these stories are deeply erotic, beautifully written novellas that you can read in one evening. I love the serial format. Skye Warren really knows how to write a moving and sexy story with incredibly memorable characters! Full review to follow.

Fantastic! Perfect example of why R.K.Lilley is one of my favorite authors. Character connection, great storyline and off-the-charts, need-a-cold-shower sex scenes. Bad ThingsR.K. Lilley 
 R.K. Lilley is one of my favorite writers and boy does she deliver an amazing story in Bad Things! I could not get enough of Danika and Tristan and I am anxiously awaiting more of their story. 
 There is no insta-love here. The author takes the time to build a deep friendship between Danika and Tristan but they do have an undeniable chemistry that they cannot ignore. Danika has a long list of strict rules for relationships and Tristan, well, let's just say that Tristan falls into the bad-boy category which Danika is trying to avoid. 
 Danika is totally honest and open with Tristan. He is who he is, and in his own way, is honest with Danika, too. If you have read the Up in the Air series (not necessary for this book but an amazing series), you know that Bad Things takes place several years before James Cavendish meets Bianca, and that Tristan gets clean and sober. You also know that something very tragic happens between Tristan and Danika. 
 There are several fantastic plot twists that I did not see coming in Bad Things. There are also several well-developed side characters with great stories. But Bad Things focuses on the EXPLOSIVE attraction and oh-so-steamy sex between Tristan and Danika and the author really knows how to deliver some heart-pounding sex scenes! Writers, take note: this is how you write contemporary romance! 
 "Oh, I like this one, I thought, watching his throat work as he swallowed. A sexy man who liked sarcastic women..." 
 - Danika 
 "You feel so good, sweetheart. I swear nothing's ever felt better in my whole fucking life." 
 - Tristan 
 I could not out this book down. I absolutely loved the characters and I want to know much more about Tristan and Danika's journey. Bad Things is must-read book by an amazing author. Enjoy the ride!

Rock My World is a very sexy entry in the Black Falcon series! 
 It is a fairly quick and very entertaining read. The story follows Aubrey and Zach (Riff's "real" name), as they return to Aubrey's home to meet with her father over a legal matter. Except that Aubrey hasn't told her parents she was bringing home her tattooed, rocker boyfriend! The awkward situation with Aubrey's very conservative parents only adds to Zach's insecurities, as he struggles to convince himself that he is good enough for Aubrey. 
 Much drama and hot sex then ensues in this very steamy novella. Will Zach and Aubrey let outside influences drive them apart? Will Aubrey cave in to her conservative parents and leave Zach? Everything comes to a very satisfying conclusion in this story. As usual, Michelle Valentine really delivers a catchy plot with very memorable characters and some scorching hot scenes. 
 I love Aubrey and Zach. Rock My World is a great entry in the Black Falcon series, and I'm looking forward to reading Trip's story next, in Rock the Beat!

Just Human has one of the most engrossing story lines of any book I have ever read. It's surprising, modern and sexy. Combined with the relatable Liv and the gorgeous but very human Danny, Just Human is one of my favorite books of the year! 
 Danny and Liv were childhood best friends in the UK which then blossomed into first love. But Danny's family left suddenly for the US and he and Liv lost touch. Thanks to Facebook, they find each other and reconnect again as adults. Kerry Heavens really gets the whole social media experience right when she describes the messaging between Danny and Liv. For anyone who has ever secretly stalked an old crush online, the way Danny and Liv meet up again is fresh, modern and totally realistic! 
 In their years apart, Liv has become a hard-working, small-business owner in the UK and Danny has established a successful computer consulting company in California. He impulsively decides to meet up with Liv after many years of silence between them. The author writes in an alternating POV, which I am a HUGE fan of! I especially loved reading Danny's POV. 
 "You can't put into ordinary words what it feels like to want something so badly for half your life and then when you get it, it's more than you could've ever hoped for." 
 Liv always loved Danny but was too proud to do anything about it. She tried to move on but realized that no one else could ever take the place of Danny in her heart. 
 "You are always rooted here with me" 
 Everything about this book exceeded my expectations. Fresh writing, characters I connected with, and VERY steamy sex scenes between Danny and Liv! The author also created very relatable supporting characters that felt essential to the story instead of just unnecessary extras. 
 Liv and Danny are two of my favorite characters. Liv is sexy but insecure, a workaholic who really does wants to have a serious and loving relationship. Danny is gorgeous, kind and smart. And a little nerdy! I love the author's pick for Danny (the gorgeous Paul Walker): 
 I really didn't want Danny and Liv's story to end! This book ends somewhat abruptly and I simply cannot wait to see where Ms. Heavens takes us in Still Human.

LOVE LOVE LOVE Toni Aleo! 4.5 stars. Wish it was longer. 
 Another delicious Nashville Assassins book from Toni Aleo! I was immediately drawn in to Jordan and Aynslee's story and absolutely love the author's writing style! Somehow the author makes these characters into real people, with real jobs, and believable problems, with the added bonus of a peek into the world of professional hockey. Is there a love at first sight story in Falling for the Backup? Yes, but the author makes it very believable and not cliche at all. 
 I will admit that I have been a huge fan of Toni Aleo since "Taking Shots", her first book in the Assassins series, so I jumped at the chance to read Falling for the Backup. (You do not, however, need to read any of the other books to enjoy this one, since it is a standalone novella.) 
 When Jordan is sidelined by an injury, he fights to get his professional hockey career back, but also feels like he is not worthy of getting involved with the beautiful and vivacious Aynslee. His self-esteem is tied to his ability to play hockey. Toni Aleo had me literally on the edge of my seat until I finished this novella. And the sex scenes are scorching hot! If you want a relatively fast and very exciting and well-written story, Falling for the Backup is for you. (And then go read Taking Shots! You'll love it, too!) 
 (ARC provided by the author in exchange for an honest review.) 
 Falling for the BackupToni Aleo

4.5 stars!! I absolutely LOVE Emma Chase's writing style and Twisted is a delicious treat for fans of Drew and Kate! This book begins two years after Drew and Kate begin dating, and they are living together in New York City. Their chemistry is still HOT and sizzling, of course, because this is the Tangled series after all, but a very serious misunderstanding occurs which threatens the couple's Happily Ever After. What could be a simple event in the hands of another writer becomes an emotional roller coaster that kept me reading this book almost in one sitting. 
 There is tons of snappy dialogue and some very funny moments, mostly thanks to Kate's friend Delores. There are a lot of great twists and turns in this book and although I thought I would not be "hooked" on Kate's POV, I absolutely loved reading her POV. She is smart, witty, funny and sensitive. But I think my my favorite part of the whole book might be the Epilogue, which is written in my boyfriend's (oops, I mean) DREW's POV. The wonderful cast of supporting characters makes their appearances in Twisted, and I loved each and every one of them. Twisted is a funny, witty, intelligent and very sexy book and I cannot wait for Tamed!! 
 "He pulls the blanket up over both of us and holds me tight against him. And it makes me feel precious. He makes me feel that way. Always. Cherished. Adored." 
 "But to know perfection-to touch it, breathe it in every day-and then have it taken away? Loss is agony. And every inch of my skin aches with it." 
 "Even when I hated you, I loved you." - Drew

Sexy, hot and absolutely exhilarating!! 
 It is kind of scary to read a book from an author who has given you one of your most beloved book boyfriends ever. Remington Tate is still my true love but Greyson King has stolen my heart. I loved everything about Rogue, the emotion, the story, the writing, and especially the very dark and beautiful Greyson "Zero" King. 
 I couldn't put Rogue down and found myself consumed by Greyson and Melanie's story. The book swept me along for a hot and delicious ride filled with emotion, happiness, and some trepidation. Would Melanie tame her guy? Would Greyson be able to keep his secrets from Melanie without destroying them both? 
 Melanie has been unlucky at love and falls hard for Greyson. 
 "He's a ten. I've never, ever been with a ten. And the way that he looks at me... I've seen that look before. The look that Remington Tate gives Brooke. That look. He's giving it to me and I'm dying inside. Can I die from one look? And if one look can kill me, then what would one touch do?" 
 So Melanie and Greyson have unbelievably hot chemistry but the tension comes from whether their relationship will survive once his true relationship with her is revealed. 
 Greyson is everything I love about a Katy Evans hero - he's possessive, protective, hot and very demanding. I absolutely loved the writing and the story as well as the dual POV. Rogue is a totally exhilarating, sexy ride from one of my very favorite authors and I can't wait to read more from Katy!! 
 "With you and me, there are no givens. No rules. Just what we want. And I want every inch of you. I want what you've given no one." 
 (*ARC provided by the publisher in return for an honest review.)

WOW!! What a ride!! Ripped was an unexpected gem from one of my favorite authors ever and I loved it from beginning to end! Pandora is a feisty, strong, take-no-prisoners heroine who came charging out of the gate at a hundred miles an hour. From the opening scene of Ripped when she and her best friend are planning a pay-back to Mackenna, to the very end, Pandora grabbed my heart and didn't let go. 
 Pandora has always felt crushed and alone after her first and only love broke her heart. And then went on to sing about it! Her life has become focused on getting revenge on the only man she has ever loved left her with not a look back. Mackenna was her true love, before he became a famous rock star, and to her horror, he wrote a hit song about her! She has spent years hating him. 
 When her prank goes wrong, to stay out of trouble, she must make a deal that involves her going on tour with the band. Will she be able to come to terms with what Mackenna did to her all those years ago? Will Mackenna be able to make her understand why he did what he did? 
 Sex, sex, and rock-n-roll. Mackenna is a sex god and Katy Evans doesn't let you forget it! Ripped actually has more humor in it than the other books in this series and I loved it!! And of course, lots and lots of heart in this one. 
 Ripped is classic Katy Evans, with a twist! The heroine is angry and heartbroken but tough as nails. The hero is sexy as hell, possessive and tenacious. I highlighted so much from this book that I'll just share my favorite quotes here: 
 "Stupid girl attracted to bad boy, V card handed over, heart broken, end of story. I'm not even worried about him." 
 "I'm familiar with Pandora and her mistake - letting all kinds of bad shit into the world when she opened the box. I've always been at war with my name. I'm angry at it because, right away, it makes me think I can never really be good. I'm a jinx." 
 "God, I'm such a bluffer. Black clothes, black nails? I'm a pussy. An innocent little kitty pretending to be Catwoman. This man could kill me, over and over, until my nine lives are done." 
 I absolutely adored Ripped and have now added Mackenna to my list of favorite book boyfriends! 
 (ARC provided by the publisher in return for an honest review)

Katy Evans has written an intensely sexy book which perfectly ends Brooke and Remy's roller coaster ride that began in Real. Katy's intimate portrayal of Remy's innermost thoughts and feelings is always fascinating, and at times heartbreaking, as the reader witnesses his constant struggle to love, be loved and simply live in the world. 
 Remy is not a standalone book by any means and I recommend you read Real and Mine first. Katy has created an unforgettable character in Remington Tate and her books have resonated with legions of fans, myself included. I absolutely loved reading Remy's POV and devoured this book almost in one sitting. Remy is almost painfully flawed as a human being but is also desperate find love and some kind of balance in his life. His struggles are, for me, the crux of this story. I loved him through all his highs and lows and hoped he would get his HEA! 
 You know you are getting loads of steamy sex if you have read Real and Mine. And Katy Evans really delivers on the hot and VERY primal sex scenes in Remy. Whew! It is Remy's POV, after all. Remy and Brooke's scenes together are totally hot. And very, very satisfying. 
 I absolutely loved the conclusion to Remy and Brooke's story, but I was a little sad to reach the end of this book! Like all of Katy's fervent fans, l feel very connected to Remy and Brooke and hope that we hear a little more from them in the next two books, Ripped and Raw. I give Remy 5 swoony stars!!
